purpose: Coverage inventory with dated automated execution evidence; no formal WCAG conformance claim.

automationBaseline.notes: Test infrastructure only. No browser or assistive-technology versions have been inferred for manual testing.

statusDefinitions.covered: Automated test code addresses the stated scope; this does not record a passing run.
statusDefinitions.not-tested: No manual session has been performed or recorded for this activity.
statusDefinitions.passed: A recorded manual session passed its stated scope.
statusDefinitions.failed: A recorded manual session found a failure in its stated scope.
statusDefinitions.partial: A recorded manual session has incomplete coverage or mixed outcomes; results describe limitations.

automated.scope: Modal opening, Escape/backdrop dismissal, scroll lock, initial page scan and overlay motion.
automated.limitations: Recorded execution applies only to its stated source snapshot and scope; inspect run evidence and conditional skips. Initial-load axe scans do not exercise every dynamic state or language and do not replace manual testing.
